title: Fractera CONFIG — the settings of every application in one place
description: The settings of your project — languages, name, search, header, footer and twelve feature switches — on one screen. Save once, and every connected application takes them in seconds, without a rebuild.

blocks.pill: OpenSource Web4 agent & app starter kit
blocks.title: All project settings in one place
blocks.description: Languages, name, search, header, footer and twelve feature switches live on one screen. Save once, and every connected application takes the change in seconds, without a rebuild.

blocks.text: On this element’s pages, in one of eight groups, and saves.
In APP-CONFIG and PLATFORM-CONFIG, written as a patch, never overwritten.
Every subscribed application gets it the moment you save and takes the new settings itself.
The application applies them over its own defaults, and visitors see the change after reloading.
In a single project every element takes its settings from here; in an app factory a new element keeps its own.

head: Without it

rows: Settings scattered across the repositories
All settings of the project on one screen
A rebuild for a menu item or a switch
A save, and every connected application follows in seconds
Each application decides alone what to show
Twelve switches, from the top menu to the language switch
An application stops without its settings service
Every application keeps its own settings and runs without CONFIG

blocks.text: Each one turns a feature of every connected application on or off:

items: Questions and answers · page width · social networks
Theme switch · language switch · width and design-skill indicator

blocks.text: CONFIG is an addition, not a foundation. An application that connects over MCP gets one place where all its settings change; only the architect changes them, after signing in, and applications read them with the node’s key.

Built by Fractera for the [Lagrix](https://lagrix.dev) protocol and for any web2 project with more than one application. MIT license, the code is at [github.com/Fractera/fractera-config-starter](https://github.com/Fractera/fractera-config-starter).
